title: Repairing LLM-Generated Specifications with Deterministic Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2610.22568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as formalizers: given a reasoning problem expressed in natural language, they produce a formal specification that a symbolic solver can then solve, with guarantees relative to that specification. Many specifications are runnable yet semantically wrong, encoding incorrect constraints, domains, objectives, predicates, or goals, and solver-error feedback dries up once execution succeeds. Purely LLM-based diagnosis, lacking a formal ground truth, often fails to spot these errors, and its ungrounded critiques cause regressions in 11.8% of initially correct specifications in our experiments. We propose DRAGO, a repair framework that replaces this ungrounded critique with deterministic, formalism-specific diagnosis, and retains a rewrite only when the diagnosed error weight strictly decreases under a reference-free acceptance predicate. translated_title: 基于确定性诊断的大语言模型生成规约修复
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用作形式化工具：给定一个以自然语言表达的推理问题，它们生成一个形式化规约，符号求解器随后可以基于该规约进行求解，并获得相对于该规约的保证。许多规约虽然可以运行，但在语义上是错误的——它们编码了错误的约束、定义域、目标、谓词或最终目标，而且一旦执行成功，求解器的错误反馈就不再提供信息。纯粹基于LLM的诊断由于缺乏形式化的真值标准，往往无法发现这些错误，并且在我们的实验中，其无根据的批评导致11.8%最初正确的规约出现退化。我们提出了DRAGO，一个修复框架，它用确定性的、针对特定形式化方法的诊断取代了这种无根据的批评，并且只有当诊断出的错误权重在无参考接受谓词下严格减少时，才保留重写结果。在涵盖逻辑推理（SMT-LIB...
tldr: 提出DRAGO修复框架，用确定性的、针对特定形式化方法的诊断取代LLM无根据的批评，且仅在诊断错误权重严格减少时才保留重写，从而有效修复LLM生成的可运行但语义错误的形式化规约。
en_tdlr: DRAGO replaces ungrounded LLM critique with deterministic, formalism-specific diagnosis and retains rewrites only when diagnosed error weight strictly decreases, effectively repairing LLM-generated specifications that are runnable yet semantically wrong.
